Trace number: 14 / Claim ID: 482j4y (Student-teacher relations, STRUDREL)
Coded claim 4 text (original paper): “Contrary to predictions, the Student-Teacher
Relations x School-Average Mathematics Ability interaction was not statistically significant.
Irrespective of their perceptions of student-teacher relations in their schools, students in
high-ability schools had lower mathematics self-concepts. [Table 3, Social (SE), Student-
Teacher Relations, School-Average Ability x Moderator: .012 (.005)]”

Replication outcome: Simple test
Inferential criteria: Simple test inferential criteria (if relevant): Criteria for a successful
replication is a statistically insignificant (alpha = .01) unstandardized moderation effect
(School-Average Mathematics Ability X Student-Teacher Relations), indicating that student-
teacher relations do not moderate the BFLPE. Replication success will not be based on
comparing the magnitude of this coefficient to other terms in the model.
Result: Not significant unstandardized moderation effect. This claim was replicated.
